control_ids.description: The IDs of the controls that the test is associated with.

control_keys.description: The keys of the controls that the test is associated with.

created_at.description: The date when this test was created.

custom.description: True if the test is custom (user generated), false if it's Secureframe-authored.

detailed_remediation_steps.description: Guidance for remediating this test in the event it fails.

enabled.description: True if the test is currently enabled.

enabled_field_updated_by_user_name.description: The name of the user who enabled the test, null if wasn't enabled by a user.

failure_message.description: The message to be displayed if the test fails.

first_failed_at.description: The date the test first failed.

framework_ids.description: The IDs of the frameworks that the test is associated with.

framework_keys.description: The keys of the frameworks that the test is associated with.

health_status.description: The overall health of the test.

key.description: The user-friendly identifier used to reference this test.

last_evaluated.description: The date the test was last evaluated at.

last_passed_at.description: The date the test last had a passing evaluation.

next_due_date.description: The date new test evidence is needed by if applicable.

owner_assigned_at.description: The date the test owner was assigned.

pass.description: True if the test is passing, false otherwise.

passed_with_upload.description: True if the test passed from the existence of an upload, false otherwise.

passed_with_upload_justification.description: The justification used on evidence upload to pass the test if applicable.

promote_at.description: The current date set for implementation of the test.

promoted_by_name.description: The name of the user who set the implementation date.

required_implementation_date.description: The pre-configured date the test must be implemented by.

resource_category.description: The category the test resource belongs to.

test_domain.description: The domain the test belongs to.

test_interval_seconds.description: The interval in which test evidence should be collected if applicable.

tolerance_window_seconds.description: The time between the test interval elapsing and evidence becoming stale and test failing if applicable. [DEPRECATED - No longer used once the At Risk Window ships. The field stays in the API and can still be read, filtered, and written, but its value will not affect any test. A new at_risk_window_seconds attribute is coming and works differently: a warning before the due date, not a grace period after a test fails.]

updated_at.description: The date the test was last updated.

vendor_name.description: The vendor name associated with the test if applicable.

description: Read personnel, devices, cloud resources, controls, frameworks, tests, vendors, risks and compliance tasks.

secureframe_new_cloud_resource_trigger.description: Runs for each new cloud resource in Secureframe. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

secureframe_new_control_trigger.description: Runs for each new control in Secureframe. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

secureframe_new_device_trigger.description: Runs for each new device in Secureframe. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

secureframe_new_framework_trigger.description: Runs for each new framework in Secureframe. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
